title: "Simulation01"
output: html_document

This notebook mirrors `TempTest.R` with the same simulation settings, but uses `ggplot2` panels for quick visual checks.

```{r setup}
source("trial_gen.R")
source("sim_runner.R")
library(ggplot2)
```

## Model parameters

```{r beta}
# Editable model parameters for this run.
beta <- list(
  baseAlpha = 4.5,
  baseKappa = 18.0,
  vnorm = 5.5,
  eta1 = 0.8,
  eta2 = 0.001,
  a = 6.0,
  ter = 0.0,
  st = 0.00
)
```

## Design

```{r design}
design <- list(
  itemN = 1:4,
  mode = c("baseline", "R_R", "R_NR"),
  preDur = 0.4,
  retDur = 0.8,
  min_sep = 30,
  even_positions = TRUE,
  redundantN = 1:4
)

x <- gen_trial_table(design, reps_per_cell = 500, seed = 42)
```

## Run simulation

```{r simulate}
sim <- sim_from_table(
  x$trial_table,
  beta = beta,
  pop_tune = "alpha",
  sim_mode = "error_only",
  smooth_gt = TRUE,
  smooth_theta_bw = 1,
  smooth_time_bw = 1,
  reuse_dist = TRUE
)

sim$cond <- cond_key(sim)
sim$cond <- factor(sim$cond, levels = unique(sim$cond))
```

## Panel label map (edit this)

```{r panel-labels}
# Replace the RIGHT-HAND side text with your own panel labels.
# IMPORTANT: the order you write entries in `label_map` defines panel order.
cond_levels <- levels(sim$cond)

label_map <- c(
  "N1_baseline_R1_cueNA_pre0.4_ret0.8" = "Set1 Baseline",
  "N2_baseline_R1_cueNA_pre0.4_ret0.8" = "Set2 Baseline",
  "N3_baseline_R1_cueNA_pre0.4_ret0.8" = "Set3 Baseline",
  "N4_baseline_R1_cueNA_pre0.4_ret0.8" = "Set4 Baseline",
  "N3_R_NR_R2_cueNR_pre0.4_ret0.8" = "Set3(2R)-NR cue",
  "N3_R_R_R2_cueR_pre0.4_ret0.8" = "Set3(2R)-R cue",
  "N4_R_NR_R2_cueNR_pre0.4_ret0.8" = "Set6(2R)-NR cue",
  "N4_R_R_R2_cueR_pre0.4_ret0.8" = "Set6(2R)-R cue",
  "N4_R_NR_R3_cueNR_pre0.4_ret0.8" = "Set6(3R)-NR cue",
  "N4_R_R_R3_cueR_pre0.4_ret0.8" = "Set6(3R)-R cue"
)

unknown <- setdiff(names(label_map), cond_levels)
if (length(unknown)) {
  stop(sprintf("Unknown condition key(s) in label_map: %s", paste(unknown, collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
}

# Keep your manual order first; append any unlabeled conditions after that.
panel_order <- c(names(label_map), setdiff(cond_levels, names(label_map)))

# Full label vector aligned to panel_order.
cond_labels <- stats::setNames(panel_order, panel_order)
cond_labels[names(label_map)] <- label_map
sim$cond <- factor(sim$cond, levels = panel_order)

# Optional global RT x-range (set to NULL to use ggplot default)
rt_xlim <- c(min(sim$rt, na.rm = TRUE), max(sim$rt, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Quick check

# ```{r quick-check}
# nrow(sim)
# length(levels(sim$cond))
# head(sim[c("itemN", "mode", "redundantN", "error_deg", "rt", "alpha", "kappa")])
# ```

## Error distributions by condition

```{r error-panels, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
ggplot(sim, aes(x = error_deg)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 180, fill = "grey80", color = "darkblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "red", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ cond, labeller = as_labeller(cond_labels)) +
  labs(
    x = "Response error (deg)",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## RT distributions by condition

```{r rt-panels, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
ggplot(sim, aes(x = rt)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "skyblue", color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ cond, labeller = as_labeller(cond_labels)) +
  labs(
    x = "RT (s)",
    y = ""
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = rt_xlim) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
